proposal.question: Finish the BOOT.md rotation the gate has flagged since 10/16 (84% of the 32,550 B read budget; finished = under 70%): which of the four named components move out of the boot-read path?
proposal.context: Four components, each a VERBATIM MOVE or a CONSOLIDATION, never a rule change: 552.LOGREAD (2,218 B, the gate log-read contract → BOOT_MODULES § Gate log-read contract) · 552.NONNEG (995 B, the Non-Negotiables block → ONE pointer line naming its three homes; a rules-overlap decision) · 552.BANNERS (766 B, the Helm-RETIRED and Deck-PAUSED banners → one line each inside step 3b; Will's two standing instructions) · 552.MEMORIES (2,060 B, § Boot-class fleet memories → BOOT_MODULES with the five hooks kept as one line in step 4b). The components were offered as bundles under lettered options, not as four separate questions.

choices.label: All four: LOGREAD + NONNEG + BANNERS + MEMORIES
choices.meaning: Move or consolidate all four components in one rotation.
choices.consequence: ≈65% of budget, rotation FINISHED, the gate's rotation_due flag clears; every rule survives verbatim at its new home; the boot runner's pointers re-aimed in the same commit. No money; no rule's meaning moves. Counts as a process-class change under the session ceiling.

choices.label: LOGREAD + MEMORIES only
choices.meaning: The two verbatim moves, no consolidation of Non-Negotiables or banners.
choices.consequence: ≈68%, finished; the Non-Negotiables duplication and the banners stay in the boot-read path.

choices.label: Defer again
choices.consequence: Every boot keeps paying ~4.5 KB of history; the gate keeps flagging rotation_due.

recommendation.reason: Finishes the rotation in one pass with every rule surviving verbatim at its new home; B leaves the file within 2 points of the stop and the duplication in place.

caveats: Approval scope is the BUNDLE named by option A: the four components are implementation scope of one decision, not four independently answerable units (Will was never offered 'NONNEG alone' or 'BANNERS alone').
The approved form of the NONNEG component was ONE pointer line; the executed form differs — see corrections.
Plan + result cold reads (Sonnet) required under the Review budget; a plan record with exact OLD/NEW text before any edit.
